## Why this is the right fix

**Dark-mode selector format.** The task requires `.dark\:text-red-50:is([data-theme="dark"] *)` and elimination of the old `:is([data-theme="dark"] .dark\:text-red-50)` form. I tested every candidate strategy:

| `['class', '[data-theme="dark"]']` | `:is([data-theme="dark"] .dark\:…)` (old) | `.dark\:…:is([data-theme="dark"] *)` (new, but version-dependent) |
| `['selector', …]` | `:where(…)` ✗ | `:where(…)` ✗ |
| **`['variant', '&:is([data-theme="dark"] *)']`** | **correct ✓** | **correct ✓** |
